notes.hashtagVideoGeo: TikTok limits hashtag video lookups to the hashtag's own top-5 countries, so example videos may come from another market. Each example records countryUsed.
notes.instagram: Instagram publishes no trending-audio metrics and no country filter, and media objects carry no audio field. IG rows are unranked names; use the manual log for Instagram.
notes.keywords: TikTok trending search keywords have no volume and no country parameter. Order only.
